recipes.name: Grilled Lemon Parmesan Asparagus
ingredients_raw: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or more if needed
1 tablespoon lemon juice, or more if needed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.25 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus extra for topping

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.

Place asparagus in a large, shallow bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, going from bottom to top of stalks. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over asparagus; lightly toss to coat each spear.
Use tongs to transfer coated asparagus to the preheated grill. Grill to desired tenderness, 3 to 7 minutes.
Remove asparagus from the grill and place onto a serving plate. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan.

raw_recipe.headline: Grilled Lemon Parmesan Asparagus
raw_recipe.description: Jazz up your asparagus with Parmesan cheese and lemon juice before placing it on the grill.

review.reviewBody:
Am giving your tasty recipe a four star rating. Would have given it a five had you punched up the flavor by marinating the asparagus first.

To marinate: Place the asparagus in a shallow baking dish, triple the lemon juice and olive oil, drizzle over the asparagus and marinate at room temperature for one hour, turning about three or four times. Then drain off the marinade and toss with the parmesan to coat. Be sure to use fresh Parmesan instead of the jarred type that has added salt and chemicals to keep it from lumping during storage.

If your grill doesn't have a grill plate use two bamboo skewers instead of one to thread asparagus spears for easy turning and to help keep the asparagus from slipping through the bars. Heck, whether you have a grill plate or not use the skewers for easy turning ;-)

If you're a garlic and lemon flavor lover add one teaspoon of minced garlic to the lemon and oil marinade.

I prepared this recipe for the first time this weekend...for a reception serving a light dinner (for 40-50 guests with sophisticated pallets) following a concert. It was also the first time I had used the wonderfully helpful servings converter you provide. I followed the suggestion of a reviewer to marinate the asparagus before roasting. For almost 10# of asparagus, I divided the asparagus into four batches for marinating (an hour) and roasting (about 12 min.) Having roasted asparagus and other veggies previously in my oven, I had an idea about the time needed for achieving a crisp/tender outcome. I salted generously, added generous amounts of garlic to the marinade and added the shredded parmesan after roasting. Along with the last batch of aspragus I roasted a thinly sliced lemon which I added on top on of the serving platter. The dish was a hit...not a single stalk of asparagus was left to bring home! Thank you, Allrecipes, for helping me look good!!-

This recipe is similar to how I always make my roasted asparagus. I always wait to add the parmesan cheese at the end when they are done along with some more lemon juice drizzled over! Also while roasting or grilling, add in some chopped garlic, yumm.

Got a new indoor grill, and decided to try this recipe on it. It is the best way that I have had asparagus, ever! Tenderized them just right, too, by peeling the outer part of the hard ends. This is the only way that I want to make it, now.
Huge hit with the family. I marinated the asparagus in the lemon juice and olive oil before grilling. Use freshly grated Parmesan.
I broiled it in the oven for 4 minutes. Came out done but still crispy. Very good.

Really easy and really good. This is a simple recipe but the pay off is fantastic.
thank you for a great weeknight grilling recipe!
My husband and I eat this all the time. We love it. Easy/fast to make and very delicious.

Very quick and simple, yet delicious! I cannot wait to make this again. 

I love Parmesan cheese, so I grated extra and added it to the top a couple minutes before it was done. Amazing!!!
Quick and easy side dish. No need to measure ingredients. Just drizzle oil, squirt lemon, season with salt and pepper, grate cheese, toss and grill. It is that easy.

I made this for our weekly barbque and it was delicious! Made it exactly how its stated but I did marinate it about 3 hours. Am making it again this Saturday, its just that good!!! Now my favorite way to make this vegetable.
Made it according to the recipe. Did top it with a balsamic reduction glaze. My guests really loved it !
